bundle.shortDescription: The church books, for TrinityOne finance helpers.
bundle.longDescription: TrinityOne Finance opens one screen of the TrinityOne steward console: the church books, for a helper the church has approved for Finance. It talks only to the shared TrinityOne relays and keeps its key on this computer, locked with a PIN.
